authority_basis.summary: Operator directed continuation of the flavor chart-versus-physical invariant program.

operations.title: Flavor phase clustering is strongly coupled to sparse-chart modulus balance
operations.summary: Across 227 deduplicated viable minima, phase and alternating log-modulus imbalance have Pearson r=0.695 and within-oriented-orbit r=0.446 with orbit-preserving permutation p<1e-4. This is chart-groupoid evidence, not a physical invariant, because the balance coordinate is a proved Gram wall only for the zero-diagonal support.

operations.title: Cycle-modulus correlation does not establish UV phase quantization
operations.summary: The balance coordinate need not descend under weak-basis transformations and is not yet an invariant semialgebraic distance for every support.
